desc: Design the exact 2D Fenwick structure and transition logic, including sparse memory layout, strict-increase handling, and complexity verification for N,Q=2e5.
Read input $N, Q$, array $A$, and queries $(R_i, X_i)$.
Coordinate compress all values from $A$ and $X$ into a sorted unique list.
Create a list of elements `(value, index)` and sort by value. Create a list of queries `(X, R, original_index)` and sort by `X`.
Implement a 2D Fenwick tree (Fenwick tree of Fenwick trees) to support `update(idx, val, dp)` and `query(idx, val)` which returns max in rectangle $[1, idx] \times [1, val]$.
Iterate through sorted queries. For each query, add all elements with `value <= X` to the 2D Fenwick tree. To add an element `(v, i)`, compute `dp = query(i-1, v-1) + 1` and call `update(i, v, dp)`.
The answer to the current query `(X, R, original_index)` is `query(R, compressed_X)`. Store this in an answers array at `original_index`.
Test with provided samples to verify correctness.
